text: The combination of unexpected job losses (-23,000 nonfarm payrolls), GDP slowing to 1.5%, and inflation stuck at 3.4% with potential rate hikes ahead points to a stagflationary setup — be cautious adding new risk until the jobs picture stabilizes.
META is genuinely cheap at a PE of 15.7 with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — this is a rare quality-at-a-discount opportunity worth adding to on this pullback.
